desc: 暖调有色膏体，半侧分屏即刻对比，九镜从干唇痛点到选色收口
name: 奶茶棕调水光有色润唇膏款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：单品直立在一片摊开的膏体光晕上，用白底承接首图流量
先放大素唇的竖纹与暗沉起皮，让买家在对号问题上停住
同唇同机位的半侧分屏把干纹素唇与涂后水光并置，一秒给出结果证明
shots.textZone: 两栏下沿各一条空白小色块位，供两条短标注

shots.intent: 用一张通用买手式人像让买家代入上唇后的整体气质，承接对比之后的想象
shots.textZone: 左下一枚空白圆形色块位加一行短标注

shots.intent: 仰角微距看清出膏口结构与膏珠形态，用四条引线把结构与体感讲成机制
shots.textZone: 出膏口四角四个空白色块位，以细虚线引向结构

shots.intent: 在高光大膏面之上排四格图标位，用留空证明结构消除配方与质地疑虑而不编造
shots.textZone: 2x2 四格区块，每格一枚线图标位加一行标题位与两行空白正文位

shots.intent: 三种自然肤色的上唇四象限加一格膏面，让不同肤色的买家各自对号入座
shots.textZone: 第四格膏面上一行空白色名位

shots.intent: 俯视散点膏色把色域深浅一次摊开，给出选色入口而不给色号编号
shots.textZone: 每个膏点旁一枚空白小标签位

shots.intent: 用置景静物的斜倚姿态与奶茶甜点符号收口，把色系联想转成下单冲动
shots.textZone: 上部一条空白横幅位，仅一行收口文案

style.backgroundSystem: flat seamless paper only: pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot and the shade-dot screen, milk-cream #F3E7D6 for wear grids and the closing still life, toasted almond #A98F73 for portrait and surface-detail frames, deep cocoa #3E2E22 reserved for the tip macro field and for label plates; no environmental sets
style.direction: warm milk-tea tinted lip balm commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in milk-cream #F3E7D6 plus empty unbranded label plates and dashed leader lines, left as reserved proof placeholders
style.lightingSystem: soft warm 5200K studio key from the front-left with a low-contrast fill card, controlled wet specular on balm and coated lip surfaces, skimming highlight along polished edges, soft contact shadow under every upright product, no hard falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm milk-tea tinted lip balm ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, milk-cream #F3E7D6, toasted almond #A98F73 and deep cocoa #3E2E22 with one product-matched milk-tea accent; warm colour temperature throughout; flat seamless paper backgrounds only, no environmental sets; soft warm 5200K studio key from the front-left with a low-contrast fill card, controlled wet specular on balm and coated lip surfaces, skimming highlights along polished edges and a soft contact shadow under every upright product; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline and one small label maximum, every wording slot carried by a placeholder; thin single-weight line icons, empty unbranded label plates and dashed leader lines; stable upright product scale, all lip crops kept from the philtrum or nose tip to below the chin with real skin texture and no identifiable likeness; identical framing and light across grid tiles; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no platform or certification badges.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting between grid tiles
no platform, marketplace or certification badges
style.presentationRules: the product keeps one stable upright scale and one consistent silhouette on a slight eye-level axis; every lip crop stays from the philtrum or nose tip to below the chin with real texture; portrait frames use one generic model with no identifiable likeness; grid tiles keep identical framing, camera height and light
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweeps in #FFFFFF / #F3E7D6 / #A98F73 / #3E2E22, plus one low reflective shelf line used only in the closing still life; balm smears and dots always laid flat on paper so they stay grounded
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif; one short headline plus at most one small label line per frame; every wording slot is a placeholder, never source wording
